correctness.rationale: Global Lipschitz gives all secants in the interval of essential derivative extrema. Coordinatewise convexity reduces the graph anchored norm of a diagonal multiplier to binary extrema. Root-path telescoping gives the upper bound m+delta MaxCut. Maximum-cut two-level base data with a uniform infinitesimal shift give a matching lower bound. Affine case, anchor independence, and the distinction between supremum/attainment are addressed. Independent small graph exact rational diagnostics support but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The naturally defined sharp two-input graph BV stability of all scalar globally Lipschitz superpositions admits a complete arbitrary-connected-graph formula with the exact cut structure. The formula characterizes the qualitative loss of nonexpansivity, has exact path/cycle/complete-graph classifications, strong growth and exact computational hardness. The factor is not a mere relabeling of the scalar Lipschitz norm or a recomputation of an unrelated table.
